title: PEAD-ML: Elastic-net over 8-quarter SUE history (near-doubles Sharpe)
summary: Replace the single-quarter SUE signal with an elastic-net regression over 8 quarters of standardized earnings surprises. Finance Research Letters 2025 paper reports this 'nearly doubles Sharpe ratios' vs simple last-quarter SUE. The intuition: earnings trends and acceleration contain information beyond the last surprise alone.

source.paper: Beyond the last surprise: Reviving PEAD with machine learning and historical earnings
source.key_finding: Elastic-net on 8-quarter SUE history near-doubles Sharpe vs single-quarter SUE

implementation.data_needed: Historical EPS actuals and estimates — FMP API (free 250 req/day) at /v3/earnings-surprises/{symbol}
implementation.model: sklearn ElasticNetCV with cross-validation on rolling IS window
signal_construction: For each stock at each earnings date:
Filter: go long if predicted_drift > threshold (top decile)
implementation.requires: FMP historical earnings data — already have $FMP_API_KEY in vault

expected_improvement: Sharpe ~2× improvement on signal quality. Directional accuracy improves from ~63% to ~70%+. Works best when combined with H159b beta-hedge.
risks: Requires 8 quarters of EPS history — limits universe (no new listings)
Overfitting risk — elastic-net helps but 8 features per stock is borderline for many training samples
FMP free tier: 250 req/day; a 500-stock universe = 2 days of API calls to build dataset
